DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約した振込のうち、一件だけ取り消したいです。同じ相手への別の予約は残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ相手への予約二件の一方のみ取消し希望と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to cancel just one of my scheduled transfers. I want to keep another scheduled transfer to the same recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to cancel only one of two scheduled transfers to the same recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対象の日付を分けて確認しましょう。どの予約についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the dates separately. Which scheduled transfer would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 翌月十日分です。今月十日分は残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 翌月十日を対象とし今月十日は残すと具体的に指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The one for the tenth of next month. I want to keep the one for the tenth of this month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify that the transfer for the tenth of next month is the one to cancel and that the one for the tenth of this month should remain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取人が同じでも日付が違う二件ですね。予約情報を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: So there are two transfers to the same recipient on different dates. The staff member in charge will check the scheduled transfer details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。画面の一覧を開けますが、二件まとめて削除する操作はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約一覧は開けるが二件一括削除は未操作と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I can open the list on the screen, but I have not performed any operation to delete both together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you can open the scheduled transfer list but have not used any operation to delete both transfers at once. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま担当へ相談してください。取扱いの可否や時期も確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please leave it as it is and discuss it with the staff member in charge. We also need to check whether and when it can be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 取り消したい一件の額も伝えます。今月分を変更する依頼ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象額も伝え今月予約の変更依頼ではないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will also tell them the amount of the transfer I want to cancel. I am not asking to change this month's transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will also provide the amount concerned, and make clear that you are not requesting a change to this month's scheduled transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。取消しが完了したかは、受付結果と予約一覧で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Let us check whether the cancellation has been completed through the request result and the scheduled transfer list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 翌月分だけの相談と伝え、結果が確認できるまで取消し済みとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 翌月分のみ相談し結果確認前は取消完了とみなさないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that I am only asking about next month's transfer and will not consider it canceled until I can confirm the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that your inquiry concerns only next month's transfer and that you will not regard cancellation as complete before checking the result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。担当窓口へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. I will take you to the counter in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この商品は一人一個とあります。家族三人分として、私が三個買ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人一個制限を非来店家族三人分として購入できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This item says one per person. Can I buy three for the three people in my family?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may buy three of an item limited to one per person on behalf of family members who are not at the store. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この売場では、来店されたお客様お一人につき一個です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this section, the limit is one for each customer who comes to the store.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家にいる二人の分も含めると思っていました。今日は私だけ来ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族人数を含めると思ったが来店は本人一人と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the two people at home would count too. I am the only one here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought your family members counted, but that only you have come to the store. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: でしたら一個になります。余分に入れた物があればこちらで戻せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then you can buy one. If you have put extra items in your basket, we can return them for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三個かごに入れたので、二個を戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: かごの三個のうち二個を返したいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I put three in my basket, so please return two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to return two of the three items in your basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。一個はお買いになるということでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. You would still like to buy one, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。別の同じ用途の商品に制限がなければ、そちらも見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一個は購入し制限のない同じ用途の商品を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If there is another product for the same purpose without a limit, I would like to see that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will buy one and would also like to see another product for the same purpose that has no purchase limit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別商品はその商品の表示を確認してください。数だけ増やすための会計の分割はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the label for each different product. We do not split transactions just to increase the quantity you can buy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この品は一個にして、足りない分は別商品の条件を見て選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 限定品一個にして不足分を別商品の条件で選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will buy one of this item and choose another product for the rest after checking its conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will buy one of the limited item and choose other products to make up the shortfall according to their conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要でしたら売場をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I can show you the section if you need help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: バドミントンの羽根が柵の中へ飛びました。入らずに取る方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 柵内へ飛んだ羽根を立ち入らず回収する相談をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Our badminton shuttlecock flew inside the fence. I would like to ask how to retrieve it without going in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about retrieving a shuttlecock that flew inside a fence without entering the area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは管理用の区域です。どこに落ちたか外からわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a maintenance area. Can you see where it landed from outside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 木の根元に白い羽根が見えます。友人が柵を越えようとしたので止めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 木の根元の白い羽根を示し友人の越柵を止めたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see a white shuttlecock at the base of the tree. My friend tried to climb over the fence, so I stopped them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the white shuttlecock at the base of the tree and report that you stopped your friend from climbing over the fence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 越えずに待ってくださってありがとうございます。担当へ回収の相談をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you for waiting without climbing over. I will ask the staff member in charge about retrieving it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 遊びはいったん止めます。担当が来る間、羽根の位置を示せる場所にいてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遊びを中断し回収位置を示せる場所で待ちたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will stop playing for now. While we wait for the staff member, may we stay somewhere we can point out its location?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may stop playing and wait in a place from which you can indicate where the shuttlecock needs to be retrieved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 柵の外の通路をふさがない所でお待ちください。長い棒を差し込むことも控えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait outside the fence without blocking the path. Also, please do not poke a long stick through the fence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 棒で取ろうとせず、私たちの羽根だと特徴を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 棒を差し込まず私物の特徴を伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not try to get it with a stick. I will describe its features to show that it is ours.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not insert a stick and will describe the features of your own shuttlecock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。回収できるかは担当が状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The staff member in charge will check the situation to see whether it can be retrieved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 白い羽根で先端に青い印があると伝え、許可を待って柵の外にいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 白い羽根と青い先端印を説明し柵外で担当を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that it is a white shuttlecock with a blue mark on the tip, and wait outside the fence for permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the white shuttlecock with a blue mark on the tip and say that you will wait outside the fence for the staff member in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will let the staff member in charge know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: イヤホンで音楽を聞いていて、乗る列車の案内が聞こえませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: イヤホン音楽で乗車案内を聞き逃したと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was listening to music through earphones and missed the announcement for my train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you missed the boarding announcement because you were listening to music through earphones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご利用の行先を教えてください。音楽は今止められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me which direction you are traveling. Can you stop the music now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仙台方面です。今止めてイヤホンも外しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 仙台方面へ行き音楽停止とイヤホン取外し済みと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Toward Sendai. I have stopped the music and taken off my earphones.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you are traveling toward Sendai and have stopped the music and removed your earphones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、こちらの表示で行先と発車時刻を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us check the destination and departure time on this display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この時刻の列車ですね。放送が流れたからもう発車したと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示時刻を読み放送で発車済みと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is the train at this time, right? I thought it had already left because I heard an announcement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the displayed time and explain that you thought the train had already departed because of the announcement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内放送だけで発車済みとは判断できません。現在の表示と係員の案内を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: An announcement alone does not mean it has already departed. Please check the current display and the staff's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。並んでいた場所を離れたので、列の最後へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元の待機位置を離れたため列の最後へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I left the place where I was lining up, so I will go back to the end of the line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will return to the end of the line because you left your previous waiting place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。並び直してから、到着した車両の行先も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. After you line up again, check the destination on the train when it arrives too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗るまで音楽は再開せず、表示と放送を聞いて最後尾で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗車まで音楽を再開せず表示と放送で確認し最後尾で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the music off until I board, check the display and listen to announcements, and wait at the end of the line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not restart your music before boarding, will check the display and announcements, and will wait at the end of the line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お気をつけてお出かけください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この申請書を消せるペンで書きました。このまま提出できるか先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 消せるペン記入済み申請書をそのまま提出できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I filled in this application form with an erasable pen. I would like to ask first whether I can submit it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can submit an application form already filled in with an erasable pen as it is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの受付では、消せない黒い筆記具を使う案内になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The instructions at this reception desk require a non-erasable black writing instrument.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 注意書きを読まずに書きました。上からなぞれば済むのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 注意未読で記入したと説明し上書きで済むか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I filled it in without reading the note. Would tracing over it be enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote it without reading the instructions and ask whether writing over it would be sufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 重ね書きより、新しい用紙に書き直す方法をご案内しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We recommend filling in a new form rather than writing over the old one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい用紙をお願いします。内容は変えず、消せないペンで写したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新用紙を依頼し内容を変えず消せない筆記具で転記したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I have a new form? I would like to copy it using a non-erasable pen without changing the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a new form and say that you want to copy the same contents with a non-erasable writing instrument. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらです。前の用紙を見て写しても、氏名や住所はもう一度確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here you are. Even if you copy from the old form, please check your name and address again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写し間違いを防ぐため一欄ずつ比べます。古い用紙には個人情報があるので持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 欄ごと照合し個人情報の古い用紙は持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will compare each field to avoid copying mistakes. The old form contains personal information, so I will take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will compare each field and take home the old form because it contains personal information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。不要になった用紙の保管や処分にもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please also take care when storing or disposing of forms you no longer need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 黒い消せないペンで書き直し、内容を比べてから新しい用紙だけを提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 黒の消せないペンで再記入し照合後新用紙のみ提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will fill it in again with a non-erasable black pen, compare the contents, and submit only the new form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will rewrite the form in non-erasable black ink, check it against the old one, and submit only the new form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書き終わりましたらお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know when you have finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 受診する科を相談したいです。予約はありますが、まだ取り消したいと決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約未取消で受診科を検討する相談を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like advice about which department to visit. I have an appointment, but I have not decided that I want to cancel it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice about choosing a medical department while your existing appointment remains uncanceled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の予約を残したまま、相談先を確認したいということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you mean that you would like to check where to ask for advice while keeping your current appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。別の科に行くべきか自分ではわからないので、先に担当へ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別科へ行くか自己判断できず予約を残して担当へ聞きたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I cannot tell by myself whether I should visit another department, so I would like to ask the staff member in charge first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you cannot decide yourself whether to visit another department and want to ask the staff member in charge while keeping your appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付では診療科の判断をせず、相談内容を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Reception will not decide which clinical department is appropriate. We will pass your inquiry to the staff member in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の予約を取り消したという記録にしないでください。相談の希望だけ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取消記録にせず相談希望だけ記録してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do not record my current appointment as canceled. I only want to convey my request for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for only your request for advice to be recorded, without recording a cancellation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。取消しの依頼ではなく、受診先についての相談と記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I will record this as an inquiry about where to receive care, rather than a cancellation request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当へ症状を説明できるメモがあります。相談するときに使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 症状メモを持参し担当との相談に使いたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a note to help explain my symptoms to the staff member. I would like to use it during the discussion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have brought a symptom note and would like to use it when consulting the staff member in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ちのメモを担当へ見せてください。その後の予約変更が必要なら別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show your note to the staff member in charge. If an appointment change is needed afterward, we will check that separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約は残し、症状のメモで相談してから変更の必要性を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現予約を残しメモで相談後に変更必要性を確認すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep my appointment, discuss my symptoms using the note, and then check whether a change is necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will keep your current appointment, consult using your note, and afterward check whether a change is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その内容で担当へつなぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, I will connect you with the staff member in charge on that basis.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通勤路の防犯灯が一つ点いていません。どこへ知らせればよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通勤路の防犯灯一基が不点灯で連絡先を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: One of the security lights on my route to work is not on. I would like to ask where to report it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whom to contact about one security light on your commuting route that is not lit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所を確認します。周囲も暗くなっているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me check the location. Is the surrounding area dark as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣の灯りと店の照明は点いていました。あの一本だけなので、地域全体の停電かはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 隣灯と店照明は点灯しており地域停電は未確認と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The neighboring light and the shop lights were on. It was just that one light, so I do not know whether there is an area-wide power outage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish between the neighboring light and shop lights being on and an area-wide outage being unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一本の状態として伺います。柱の場所がわかる目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will take this as a report about one light. Is there a landmark that helps locate the pole?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 橋の手前の歩道です。柱の札は暗くて読めず、番号は確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 橋手前歩道の柱を示し札番号は暗くて読めなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is on the sidewalk before the bridge. It was too dark to read the plate on the pole, so I have not confirmed its number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Indicate the pole on the sidewalk before the bridge and say that you could not read its plate number in the dark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 無理に近づいたり設備に触れたりせず、場所と気づいた時刻を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not approach it unnecessarily or touch the equipment. Just tell us the location and the time you noticed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨夜八時に気づきました。いつから消えていたかは知らず、自分では直していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 昨夜八時に気づいたが消灯開始時刻は不明で未修理と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I noticed it at eight last night. I do not know when it went out, and I have not tried to fix it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed it at eight last night, do not know when it went out, and have not repaired it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理する窓口への確認方法をご案内します。今後通る際も、足元の見える経路を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain how to check with the office responsible for it. When you pass that way again, choose a route where you can see your footing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 橋の手前の一本が昨夜八時には消えていたと伝え、番号や故障原因は推測しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一基の場所と観察時刻だけ知らせ原因番号は推測しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will report that the one light before the bridge was out at eight last night, without guessing its number or the cause of the problem.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will report only the location of the one light and the observation time, without guessing the cause or number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。連絡先の案内はこちらです。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Here is the contact information. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 送る書類の一覧を二枚作りました。一枚は自分の控えですが、両方封筒へ入れそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送付一覧二枚のうち本人用控えまで同封しかけたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I made two copies of the list of documents I am sending. One is for my own records, but I almost put both in the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you almost enclosed your own copy as well as the other of two document lists. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先へ送る一覧と、お客様が残す控えを分けたいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you want to separate the list you will send to the recipient from the copy you will keep yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。送る書類は三種類です。後で何を送ったか確かめられるよう一枚残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三種類の送付書類を後で確認するため一覧一枚を残したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. There are three types of documents to send. I want to keep one list so I can check later what I sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to keep one list so you can later check the three types of documents sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封をする前に、送る物の数と一覧を見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before sealing the envelope, compare the number of items you are sending with the list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書類三種類と一覧一枚を入れます。控えのもう一枚は鞄へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類三種と一覧一枚だけ同封し本人控えは収納すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put in the three types of documents and one list. I will put the other list, my copy, back in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will enclose only three types of documents and one list, and put away your own copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それで手元に一覧が残ります。郵便の受付控えとは別の、ご自身の記録ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then you will still have a list yourself. That is your own record, separate from a postal acceptance receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。受付後にもらう控えと、自分で作った一覧を同じ袋に保管したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自作一覧と郵便受付控えを区別し同じ袋で保管したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I would like to keep the receipt I get after handing it over and the list I made myself in the same pouch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish your own list from the postal acceptance receipt and say that you want to keep both in the same pouch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 番号のある受付控えを受け取る方法を選ぶ場合は、その取扱いも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you choose a service that provides an acceptance receipt with a number, let us check how that works too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの控えを区別して残し、宛先と同封物を確かめてから封をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの控えを残し宛先と同封物確認後に封をすると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the two records separately identified, check the addressee and enclosures, and then seal the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep both records and seal the envelope after checking the addressee and enclosures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備できましたら受付へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come to reception when you are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 現金を入れたいです。ただ、帰りの交通費は手元に残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現金入金の際に帰路交通費を手元へ残したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to deposit cash. However, I want to keep the fare for my journey home with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about keeping your return fare with you when depositing cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入金したい額と、持ち帰る額を先に分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you separate the amount you want to deposit from the amount you will take home first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 全部で二万二千円あります。二万円を入れて、二千円は残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手持ち二万二千円のうち二万円入金と二千円保留を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have 22,000 yen in total. I will deposit 20,000 yen and keep 2,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that of the 22,000 yen you have with you, you want to deposit 20,000 yen and keep 2,000 yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では二万円を入金する希望ですね。二千円はお財布に戻してから確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you would like to deposit 20,000 yen. Put the 2,000 yen back in your wallet first, and then let us check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二千円を戻しました。ここにある一万円札二枚だけ入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二千円収納済みで一万円札二枚だけ入金したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have put the 2,000 yen back. I would like to deposit only these two 10,000-yen notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have put away the 2,000 yen and want to deposit only two 10,000-yen notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その二枚で二万円です。持参した全額とは別の数字になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Those two notes make 20,000 yen. That is a different figure from the total amount you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 用紙には二万二千円でなく、実際に入れる二万円を書きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申込額は持参総額でなく実入金二万円と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So on the form I should write the 20,000 yen I am actually depositing, not 22,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the requested deposit amount is the actual 20,000 yen deposit, rather than the total cash you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。金額と対象口座を確認してから手続きを進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will check the amount and destination account before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二万円の入金だけをお願いし、交通費二千円は自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二万円のみ入金し二千円は持ち帰ると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to deposit just 20,000 yen and take the 2,000 yen travel money home with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will deposit only 20,000 yen and take the 2,000 yen home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで金額を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the amount here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で作ったおかずを入れる空の容器が欲しいです。この惣菜の容器だけ買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家庭のおかず用空容器を希望し惣菜包装だけ購入できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like an empty container for food I made at home. Can I buy just the container from this prepared food?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want an empty container for homemade food and ask whether you can buy just the prepared food packaging. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは食品を入れて販売する包装です。この売場では容器だけの販売ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This packaging is used to sell the food inside it. In this section, we do not sell just the containers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中身を抜いてもらう注文ではありません。空の保存容器を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 惣菜から中身を抜く依頼でなく空保存容器を探すと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not asking you to remove the food. I am looking for an empty storage container.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are looking for an empty storage container, rather than asking for the contents to be removed from prepared food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 空の容器は日用品の棚にあります。持ち歩くためでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Empty containers are on the household goods shelf. Will you be carrying food in it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、明日の弁当用です。ふたが閉まる物を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 翌日弁当の持歩き用に閉じるふた付き商品を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, for tomorrow's packed lunch. I would like one with a lid that closes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want a container with a closing lid to carry tomorrow's packed lunch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに本体とふたを一組にした商品があります。用途や容量も表示で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is a product sold as a container and lid set. Please also check its intended uses and capacity on the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この浅い物にします。ふたを別に買う必要はありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 浅い商品を選びふたが別売でないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will choose this shallow one. I do not need to buy the lid separately, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a shallow container and confirm that the lid is not sold separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この商品は一組です。使う前の洗い方も表示にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This product is a set. The label also explains how to wash it before use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 空容器の一組を買い、説明を読んでから弁当に使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 空容器一組を購入し使用前説明を読んで弁当に使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will buy one empty container set, read the instructions, and then use it for my packed lunch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will buy one empty container set, read the instructions before use, and use it for a packed lunch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お会計へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please go to the checkout.
